requirements_source: User ruling 2026-10-10: budget ceiling is independent per Run; controller ruling T04-R1-R01 keeps the ceiling reservation key distinct from ordinary RunService reservation idempotency.

interfaces.consumes: T04-after-1 Run/attempt contracts and user budget ruling: independent per-Run cumulative token ceiling across all attempts
interfaces.produces: Short-lived one-request capability bound to tenant/run/attempt/generation/locked route/deadline/token claim; atomic one-time consume and idempotent per-attempt usage claims

nodes.verification: Fresh guarded PostgreSQL tests for independent run budgets, per-run cumulative/in-flight claims, capability replay/consume and release rejection, public reservation idempotency, usage replay/conflict and secrecy; scoped typecheck/Biome/Drizzle/diff

nodes.dependency_evidence: Appends next migration and consumes the stable per-attempt model/run contract from T04-R1; execution is serial because Drizzle migration artifacts are shared

interfaces.consumes: T04-R1 Run/attempt generation and model usage claim contract
interfaces.produces: DB-time expiry-fenced terminal CAS; reusable DB-time active-attempt lease validator; claimPending(scope,{ownerId,batchSize,leaseMilliseconds}) claims and acknowledge(scope,{eventId,claimId,ownerId}) owner/expiry-checked CAS; event message.id is stable consumer idempotency key

nodes.verification: Guarded PostgreSQL expiry-before-sweeper and expired-capability DB-time rejection, concurrent outbox-claim/old-owner-ack tests plus scoped static checks

nodes.dependency_evidence: Consumes the capability and usage APIs from R1 and live attempt validation from R2; streaming provider adaptation must target the stable Go-facing gateway contract

interfaces.consumes: One-time consumed ModelInvocationContext and per-request usage operations from R1; DB-time active attempt lease validation from R2; runtimeModelForEnvironment, resolveModelApiKey, ModelCredentialSecretReader and PlanModel
interfaces.produces: Capability-bound OpenAI-compatible streaming gateway with faithful Anthropic/tool and desktop-plan adaptations, incremental redaction and usage settlement

nodes.verification: Provider protocol/tool mapping, secret-safe incremental stream/cancellation tests; guarded DB integration and static checks

acceptance_mapping.T04-R01: T04-R1 per-run cumulative token use remains accounted across attempts; different runs independent
acceptance_mapping.T04-R02: T04-R1 issues and atomically consumes one-request capability; T04-R3 rejects route/token substitution
acceptance_mapping.T04-R03: T04-R2 database-time expiry predicate inside terminal CAS
acceptance_mapping.T04-R04: T04-R2 persistent outbox claim/ack using claim ID, owner and DB expiry CAS; at-least-once consumer dedupe by stable event id
acceptance_mapping.T04-R05: T04-R3 canonical tool-call/tool-result mapping for Anthropic
acceptance_mapping.T04-R06: T04-R3 incremental bounded SSE forwarding and cancellation
acceptance_mapping.T04-R07: T04-R3 concrete API credential/model adapter plus existing desktop PlanModel adapter

execution: Serial SDD in one managed worktree, no commits or stashes; each task must be independently validated and reviewed before downstream work
